InQuest punch-out miniature of [[R'kik D'nec, Hero Of The Dune Sea]] in a toploader, the unpunched insert (Endor expansion advertisement on the backing), and the regular-size Jabba's Palace original. Still at 0:22 of ''Guide - SW:CCG Collection - Oversized/Undersized Cards''.

Fair use of a video still for identification of the physical magazine punch-out on [[Oversized cards]]. Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=frvqLMqMc14 The CCG Collector] (29 November 2015). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/youtube-frvqLMqMc14 Internet Archive].
